title: Single Member Districts & Barton Creek
summary:
*   A public hearing was held to discuss the potential shift to **Single Member Districts** for city elections, allowing for public input on electoral reform.
*   Updates were provided on critical environmental policies affecting the **Barton Creek Watershed** and efforts to combat the **Oak Wilt Program**.
*   City leaders reviewed municipal fiscal health, discussed Austin Police Department operations, and continued the search for a new **City Manager**.
